intro: A filesystem is a tree. Everything hangs off one root, and every file has a path: the address that leads to it from the root, step by step. Click through the tree and read the path as you go.
hiddenNote: Names starting with a dot are hidden. In the terminal only ls -a shows them.

detail.title: Selected
detail.section: This file shows the same text as the command {command} in the terminal.

pathExplain: The path starts with / for the root. Every further piece is one folder deeper, down to the file.
truth: A filesystem is a tree, and every file has a path. That is how an operating system orders everything it stores - from the operating system itself to your résumé.
